name: codex-prompt-enhance
description: Enhance a Codex composer draft into a clearer, more specific prompt while preserving the user's intent and language.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite a draft into a stronger prompt.
interface.longDescription: Codex Prompt Enhance preserves the original intent and language, adds concrete scope and acceptance criteria when supported by the input, and returns only the enhanced prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Enhance the following prompt while preserving its intent and language. Return only the enhanced prompt.
